purpose: Manual CMS portal package for the opened Calm Harbor Spa PIM surfaces
constraints: The package must be served from dev-1.servicewand.com so the public PIM request remains same-origin.
Only pricing and products are opened live. Other portal entities must not be represented as live.
Customer sign-in uses the Core OIDC redirect flow and its registered same-origin callback. The CMS template never handles a password, API key, or access token.
A signed-in user does not open private customer data in this package. Orders, appointments, tasks, profile data, and mutations remain closed until their customer-scoped backend contracts are proven.
